title: an invalid git URL is a usage error that leaves the setting as it was

checks.name: stderr matches /Invalid git repository URL 'notaurl'/
checks.detail: ✖ Invalid git repository URL 'notaurl' Expected an https or ssh URL, an scp-like address (git@host:org/repo.git) or an absolute path. → Pass a valid value, e.g. ajs config set git https://github.com/acme/interfaces.git
